description: The plot, titled “Hidden State Mean,” illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers in a model, comparing three conditions: “hidden state mean before gate” (dashed blue line), “hidden state mean after gate” (dotted orange line), and “hidden state mean of baseline” (solid green line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” ranges from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” is linear and ranges from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The dashed blue line (“before gate”) starts near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively flat until layer 10, then gradually increases to about 0.9 by layer 20, and sharply jumps to over 4 by layer 22. The dotted orange line (“after gate”) and solid green line (“baseline”) both remain close to zero across all layers, with the orange line slightly rising to about 0.15 near layer 20 and the green line staying nearly flat at 0.04. The legend indicates average values: 0.71 for “before gate,” 0.05 for “after gate,” and 0.04 for “baseline,” consistent with the visual trends. The caption notes that baseline and post-gating values are similar, which is evident from their nearly overlapping low magnitudes compared to the pre-gating values.
